en.content: 10 resistors each of resistance 10 can be connected in such as to get maximum and minimum equivalent resistance. The ratio of maximum and minimum equivalent resistance will be ___________.
en.explanation:
When resistors are connected in series, the equivalent resistance is the sum of individual resistances. Therefore, the maximum equivalent resistance will be when all 10 resistors are connected in series, giving a total resistance of 100 .

When resistors are connected in parallel, the reciprocal of the equivalent resistance is the sum of the reciprocals of individual resistances. Therefore, the minimum equivalent resistance will be when all 10 resistors are connected in parallel, giving a total resistance of 1 .

The ratio of maximum to minimum equivalent resistance is thus .

en.content: A closed circular tube of average radius 15 cm, whose inner walls are rough, is kept in vertical plane. A block of mass 1 kg just fit inside the tube. The speed of block is 22 m/s, when it is introduced at the top of tube. After completing five oscillations, the block stops at the bottom region of tube. The work done by the tube on the block is __________ J. (Given g = 10 m/s).
en.explanation:
From work energy theorem

The negative sign indicates that the work done by frictional force (the tube) is in the direction opposite to the displacement of the block. In conclusion, the work done by the tube on the block is 245 J.
